findings.summary: Dashboard greeting renders 'Captain Captain' due to duplicate title prefix
findings.evidence: The page text reads 'Good morning, Captain Captain'. The user's stored display name is 'Captain Ahmad Fauzi' (visible in the sidebar), so the greeting code is prepending the hard-coded label 'Captain' to the full name string which itself already begins with 'Captain', producing the doubled word.
steps_to_reproduce: Read the greeting at the top of the main content area
findings.expected: Greeting should read 'Good morning, Captain Ahmad Fauzi' or 'Good morning, Ahmad Fauzi'
